Formal R201B changes only the objective versus completed R201A FIXED, while native checks exercise fixed and adaptive controls. checks.evidence: shared_identity_axis.py:20-25,95-128 creates sqrt(.75)*normalized private5120 plus sqrt(.25)*normalized shared512, returns that fused5632 descriptor at output[1] and during evaluation, and supplies four RGBNT201 score/feature pairs weighted [1,1,.25,1]. rgbnt201_ranked_outlet.py:40-58 keeps every original full CE/triplet call and .25 partial CE plus .5 existing cross-gallery triplet, then adds weight1 smooth AP separately to full and partial losses. checks.requirement: Correct RGBNT201 rank masks and training-only GT
checks.evidence: rgbnt201_ranked_outlet.py:11-32 uses only batch training identity/camera labels. Similarity differences are s[i,k]-s[i,j], candidate self k=j is removed, same-ID/same-camera junk is removed from both ranks, and positives require the same ID with a different camera. Other-ID same-camera records remain legal negatives. Only queries with a legal positive enter mean AP; a wholly ineligible batch returns differentiable zero. This matches the installed RGBNT201 camera exclusion used by full_evaluation and audit_full_official49.

checks.requirement: Frozen original identity, FP32 fusion and unchanged forward/BN calls
checks.evidence: original_identity_anchor.py:15-25,28-52,55-95 remains unchanged. Fixed BACKBONE, three reducers and generalFusion have requires_grad=False and are restored to eval mode by train(), including their buffers. assert_anchor_unchanged checks modes, requires_grad and exact state tensors. The same FP32 base fusion is used in both native controls. The ranked step still makes exactly one full forward and one partial forward; smooth_ap uses tensor arithmetic only. Full/partial head calls and BN calls therefore match the original step.

checks.requirement: Ranking gradients enter the real optimizer update
checks.evidence: rgbnt201_ranked_outlet.py:43-64 includes full rank in the first backward and partial rank in the second backward. The full descriptor is differentiable in both similarity arguments; FP32 casts retain autograd. The full gallery is detached only at the pre-existing partial boundary. One zero_grad, two backwards, one unscale, one scaler.step and one scaler.update remain. verify_rgbnt201_ranked_anchor.py:18 replaces verifier.step, so its real native update and Adam replay consume the ranked step, not the old R201A update. Numerical native/autograd execution is still required.
